title: Handle-Based Resource Management with Generational Counters
description: All GPU and persistent resources use HandleMap<T> with generational counters. No raw pointers cross abstraction boundaries. When a resource is destroyed, its generation increments. Holders of old handles get 'invalid' on access rather than use-after-free. This pattern is used for RHI resources (buffers, textures, pipelines), ECS entities (via EnTT), and Lua entity references (64-bit packed lightuserdata).
whenToUse: For any resource with create/destroy lifecycle that may be referenced from multiple locations. For cross-thread resource references. For any handle passed to Lua or serialized.
whenNotToUse: For stack-local temporaries. For resources with guaranteed lifetime matching their owner (use unique_ptr).
